name: Vampire
tagline: Centuries of hunger, an eternity of shadow
blurb: You are a vampire, a creature of the night bound by an eternal thirst. Your existence is a cycle of feeding, hiding, and rising. The sun is your enemy, but the darkness is your domain. You command blood magic, move with preternatural speed, and your senses pierce the veil of night. But every gift has a price — and your hunger is never truly sated.

name: Human
blurb: You are human, untainted by the curse of vampirism but no less capable. Where vampires rely on dark gifts, you rely on wit, will, and the enduring fire of mortality. You walk freely in sunlight, forge alliances where others see only prey, and your ambition is unbounded by the limitations of the damned.

name: Werewolf
tagline: New to this world, already hunted
blurb: You are a werewolf, a creature caught between two natures. By day you walk among mortals, but when the moon rises the beast stirs. Your strength, speed, and senses far outstrip any natural predator. The curse grants you power, but control is a constant battle — and every transformation threatens to be your last.

name: Mytt
blurb: You are a Mytt, a being whose form is suffused with raw magical energy. Mortal flesh anchors you to the physical world, but your spirit brushes against realms beyond. Magic is not something you study — it is something you are. Spells flow through you like breath, and the veil between worlds is thinner in your presence.

name: Talam
tagline: Changed by magic, bound to the wild
blurb: You are Talam, changed by magic and bound to the wild. The earth reshaped you when the world began to change, leaving you as an imperfect joining between man and nature. Whether changed under the sun, the moon, or the twilight between them, you carry the wild within you.
